expanded_prompts.default:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original creature portrait sprite for a 2D creature-raising game
Primary request: Create exactly one full-body creature following the complete independent brief below. This is a new design; do not base it on any existing character.
Management only, do not render text: sm-arcane-003 / フタネリコ / 魔体 (arcane)
Body and exact anatomy: 体幹1節の先端が二股に分かれた細長い音叉形。脚6本、目2個、翼0枚、まっすぐな尾2本
Materials and biological motif: 振動を保つ半透明の音膜。地面の静かな振動を拾い、小川沿いで反響を整える
Primary, secondary, accent colors respectively: #69B8C8; #493D82; #F4EEBA
Three mandatory visual identifiers: 前端の二股は平行で同じ長さ; 目は二股の根元に横並び; 後端の二本尾は短長が明確に異なる
Pose: 六脚を低く開き、二股の前端を少し持ち上げる
Temperament to convey through expression or posture: 聞き上手。大きな音からはそっと離れる. If the brief specifies zero eyes or no face, do not invent eyes or facial features; express temperament through posture only.
Style: cohesive hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration, clear dark colored contour, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, appealing natural creature proportions, clean readable form.
Composition: isolated single creature, full body; by default use a slight top-down three-quarter view facing toward image-right. If the individual pose explicitly requires a front or top view, that explicit pose takes priority. Preserve the specified pose and physical left/right features. Centered in a square canvas, no cropping. Keep transparent padding on all sides. Intended final canvas is 1024 by 1024 pixels, with the longest creature extent about 768–896 pixels and at least 64 pixels of clear padding.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no diffuse glow. Habitat, rocks, water surfaces and action scenery mentioned in the brief describe only body posture or temperament; do not render those objects or environments.
Constraints: preserve exact anatomy, all three identifiers and the position of the palette colors; no costume or held tool unless explicitly part of the brief.
Individual forbidden changes: 二股を角のある動物頭にしない; 尾を一本にまとめない; 打楽器のばちを持たせない
Avoid: extra creatures, humans, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, gradients bleeding into the transparent area, photorealism, 3D render, imitation of an existing character.
Edit the attached own4-leg candidate to EXACTLY SIXlegs. Keep its forkbody, equalfrontprongs,TWOeyes, unequalstraighttails, palette andpose. ADD TWOshortfar-sidelegs withfullyvisiblefoottips: one farrearfoot above-leftofbodybetweentailbaseandmidbody, one farmiddlefoot above-middleofbodybehindeyes, extendingup-leftintosilhouettefreearea. Existing4legs preserved. Final6feet mustallseparated; usehigher3quarterview andspreadlegs. Noextraeyes/tails/prongs/bodysegments. Wholecreaturefills85percentcanvas withcleantransparentpadding, zeroalpha haze/marks.

All three identifiers must remain recognizable: 前端の二股は平行で同じ長さ; 目は二股の根元に横並び; 後端の二本尾は短長が明確に異なる
Locked pose: 六脚を低く開き、二股の前端を少し持ち上げる
Locked temperament/expression: 聞き上手。大きな音からはそっと離れる. Preserve eyeless or faceless designs without adding eyes or a face; for those designs use posture to convey temperament.

Preserve exact counts of eyes, limbs, wings, tails and other declared structures. Simplify surface texture, never delete identity features or invent anatomy.

Individual forbidden changes: 二股を角のある動物頭にしない; 尾を一本にまとめない; 打楽器のばちを持たせない
Avoid: antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients, semitransparent pixels, inconsistent pixel sizes, painterly miniatures, pixelation overlays, extra characters, text, letters, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, redesign.
CRITICALcounts: SIXshortlegs andSIX separatefoottipclusters. THREEnearfeetbelowbody, THREEfarfeet abovewithfrontfartip shiftedslightlyoutfrombehindprongs soall6areclear. Eachfoot tip atleast3x3logicalpixels. ONEcontinuousforkbody, TWOparallel equalfrontprongs, TWOlarge sidebysideeyes withdarkrings andcreamcenters, TWOstraightbacktails UNEQUALlength, noanimalhead/wings/arms. Sameapprovednormalpose/palette/proportions. Native128logicalgrid,coarse3tone membraneclusters,24flatcolors,1pxdarkoutline; retainnoiselesssolidclusters.
